parameters.name: AcceleratorId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance for which you want to query traffic policies.

parameters.name: Address
parameters.description: The IP address of the traffic policy destination.

parameters.name: EndpointGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint group for which you want to query traffic policies.

parameters.name: EndpointId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint for which you want to query traffic policies.

parameters.name: ListenerId
parameters.description: The ID of the listener for which you want to query traffic policies.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to **ap-southeast-1**.
